name: Stablecoin net-flow surge -> intraday deployment snipe (4h bars, fractional hold)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the daily net-flow variant: this trades the SAME dry-powder-deployment-lag thesis on a 4h clock with a sub-day-to-few-day hold, targeting the fast window in which a fresh mint is deployed to spot before the market fully reprices — a higher-frequency expression of the deployment lag): a positive stablecoin_net_flow_usd surge is fresh fiat that must chase a risk asset; on a 4h bar the deployment can be captured intraday-to-2-days before the flow is common knowledge. Entry: net-flow above a fitted surge AND price momentum non-negative on the 4h clock. Fast exit on flow fade or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: at 4h the flow/price correlation is even weaker and fee drag is heavier -> KILL unless the net-of-fee edge clears DSR>=0.95 (round-trip cost dominates at this frequency). DISCONFIRMER 2: if the daily variant (04) captures all of it, the intraday clock adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 3: coincident-not-leading flow = null; require positive lead coefficient. High death probability by design — a frequency probe.
catalyst: fresh stablecoin mint deploying to spot within hours
